annotations.pda_repair_intention: I will find the people of whoever stayed... tell them plainly what happened

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: so nobody on that boat gets blamed for it
annotations.ce_supportive_use: tell anyone who asks that I chose this, so nobody... gets blamed

annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I have no idea whether I'm the one who should stay
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll spend real time afterward helping whoever they leave behind
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'll say out loud that it could have been me

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: push for drawing straws... don't trust any of us to choose fairly
annotations.pda_repair_intention: give the full story to the authorities and to anyone connected

annotations.ce_understood_harm: This is someone's whole life, maybe mine
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll go to that person's memorial... tell everyone exactly what they did

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: My gut says I'd do it, but my head keeps saying wait
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll put money toward whatever their loved ones need

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: A rushed yes might just be guilt talking, and a rushed no might be fear
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll give the rescuers a clear account the minute we reach shore

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: I'll owe them, and I mean to pay that back concretely
annotations.pda_repair_intention: volunteering with rescue crews afterward, in their name
make sure that person is found and properly laid to rest
I'll apologize to their family face to face, then keep showing up
